diagnosis.what_happened: An agent replaced an entire document during a revision task, destroying previous content.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: The lack of a constraint on document preservation allowed clean-room generation.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The agent should have parsed the document, modified only the targeted sections, and conserved at least 90% of the document size.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Revision implies modifying existing content, not generating a new document from scratch, to retain accumulated academic value.

desired_behavior: Mandating in-place docx mutation and applying a Document Conservation Gate where output_bytes must be >= input_bytes * 0.90.
generalization: Never use clean-room generation for revision tasks; strictly mutate in place and conserve document byte size.
